summary: Cabot Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $350 million senior notes offering (4.950% due 2029) under an existing shelf registration. Proceeds will redeem $250 million of 3.40% notes due September 2026 and for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt issuance and refinancing, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, or other covered category applies. The filing includes the supplemental indenture and legal opinion. What to watch: no special-situation angle; monitoring would focus on ordinary debt maturity management.
